Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Shri Pankaj Bharti, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Shri Vibhav Anand Singh,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.
Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.62 of 2020, under Sections 366 and 376 I.P.C., Police Station Doghat, District Baghpat, during the pendency of trial.

4. As per prosecution story, the applicant alongwith co-accused person Ankit Rana and others are stated to have taken the informant to Haridwar, Rishikesh whereby the co-accused person Ankit Rana is stated to have subjected her to sexual assault and even is stated to have administered her some obnoxious material.

sentences.text: person
Ankit Rana.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the FIR is delayed by more than one year and even a male child was born out of the said corporeal relationship of the informant with co-accused person Ankit Rana.
The applicant is the relative of the main accused person Ankit Rana and his name was exonerated by the police, as such a closure report was filed with respect to him.

Later on,
during trial the applicant has been summoned by the court concerned by invoking the powers under Section 319 Cr.P.C. on 02.09.2022.
The applicant has himself surrendered before the court and is in jail since 25.01.2023.
There is no likelihood of applicant absconding and even there is no likelihood of early conclusion of trial.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application and has stated that the victim and other witnesses have categorically indicated the involvement of the applicant in the crime, although he could not dispute the fact that the closure report was filed with respect to the applicant and he has been summoned under Section 319 Cr.P.C.
7.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant- Praveen Kumar Rana @ Pramendra involved in aforementioned case crime number be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two heavy sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii). The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
(iv) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected.

(v) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
